name: S2 — a fold the operator has open is never archived
why: A long turn keeps its newest ten reasoning blocks as their own folds and rolls everything older into one archive. If a block the operator has open rolls into that archive, its fold disappears and the archive is closed — the chat shut something they were reading (18 Nov, again 19 Nov). An open fold must stay out of the archive until it is closed or the turn ends.
